discovery.scope: The live dedicated customization collection showed six products. Each of the six collection product pages has an Insignia Personaliseer link. The public sitemap contains 1,010 product URLs, but this audit did not probe all 1,010 pages for configuration links; therefore six is the verified dedicated-collection scope, not an authoritative total of every Insignia-configured SKU in the shop.
discovery.sourceCapture: Read-only live storefront UI and public Shopify product/sitemap GETs; no source product edits, artwork uploads, cart actions, or checkout. Public app-proxy configuration was opened only for product/variant IDs shown by the product UI. Temporary signed media query strings were stripped from this file.

publicCatalogAudit.catalogBoundaryNote: The six `ontwerp-je-eigen-*` handles in the dedicated `ontwerp-zelf` collection were verified as current customizer products through their public Personaliseer links. The catalog contains many designed garments and a separate test-named product; this inventory does not claim to have checked every public product for an Insignia link or config.

recordEncodingNotes.variantIds: Nested color/size maps preserve the exact source variant ID for each observed option tuple. Shared per-variant price and availability are recorded alongside each product where they are uniform.
recordEncodingNotes.geometry: Base geometry maps store only non-null configured view regions; omitted view IDs had null source geometry. Color override maps are patches containing only changed fields and inherit unspecified dimensions/coordinates from the base geometry.
recordEncodingNotes.media: Source URLs are unsigned paths; temporary X-Amz query parameters were stripped. Shopify `?v=` asset version parameters are stable public CDN identifiers and are retained.
recordEncodingNotes.pickerResize: The selected DEV image picker normalizes uploaded images to a maximum 1200 px edge. Percentage geometry remains proportional after proportional resizing. Record source decoded dimensions and target dimensions inspected after upload; only adjust historical calibrationPxPerCm proportionally when that resize relationship is verified. Otherwise leave physical calibration unresolved. Source calibration values here are historical config data, not new physical measurements.
recordEncodingNotes.captureDate: All six product/variant config captures and visible customizer UI checks were completed 2026-11-08 UTC.
